scope: Read-only pre-pilot review of the six immutable001 source copies, actual317+14 schema and listed evidence. Mechanical temporary projection/sampling/history/representation probes only. Prior H/baseline/source-target proofs retained without rerunning them.

findings.title: Nested source metadata leaks original hidden hands and changes the observation-derived sampling seed.
findings.minimalReproduction: Add debugHiddenHands to an otherwise valid state.match.opts, or to an otherwise valid PublicStep row. assertRootHistory accepts the valid game/history, toVisibleRoot structuredClone copies the unknown nested field, and sampleVisibleWorld accepts it. The same genuine own/public state and same model331 input, but a valid alternate original hidden layout inside this metadata, produces a different observationSHA and sampled layout under the same caller seed.
findings.impact: The payload is not a strict own/public projection. A teacher could receive the original opponent hands, and sampled finite worlds become keyed to source-private metadata. Top-level selection plus a content SHA is insufficient.
findings.requestedClosure: Explicitly project all allowed fields recursively for rules, result, card, combo, wildcard assignment, tribute/return, history row and every event type. Source debug extras must not survive into the payload/hash. Strictly validate all nested sampler-input fields/types/arrays and reject forged extras even after the caller recomputes the content hash. Preserve legitimate past public result fields; exclude original hidden hands, RNG, next action and future results.

findings.title: Accepted terminal-rule variation is absent from model331 and receives no representation-gap flag.
findings.impact: The encoder has no passA feature. For the same fresh hands/levels[14,2], head3 and double are both accepted with identical331 inputs and gaps[], while the same finish order[0,1,2,3] passesA only under head3. This is a concrete public condition relevant to the complete-match objective, not a label-derived eligibility criterion.
findings.requestedClosure: For this fixed-rule pilot, explicitly enforce the predeclared frozen rule identity at the ingress. If broader rule contexts are intentionally accepted, conservatively flag/isolate the unencoded variation before any scoring/labeling; do not silently expand student input or mix these tasks. A globally fixed rule need not be newly encoded if it is actually enforced as constant.
findings.scopeLimit: This does not show that the already frozen DEFAULT_RULES baseline/H measurements are wrong; they are not re-opened here.

findings.title: The attempt cap is not constrained to a safe bounded integer range.

ordinaryThreeAttemptBound.instrumentation: One side-effect-only global iteration counter added to a separate temporary source copy; no sampling/acceptance code changed.

findings.impact: Number.isInteger accepts9007199254740994. A rejecting loop can reach2^53 where attempt++ no longer changes the value while remaining below that accepted cap. Ordinary caps work, but the public boundary does not establish the claimed bounded rejection. No long-running loop was executed.
findings.requestedClosure: Require a positive safe integer and a finite predeclared maximum consistent with the existing4096 default/protocol. Reject invalid limits before allocating/shuffling. Do not enlarge the cap after inspecting label outcomes or substitute source truth on exhaustion.

nonblockingObservations.interpretation: In a fully legal266-action history, actor2 has25 cards and the two other nonempty seats each have1; the entire unseen pool is twoS9 physical copies. model331 contains this suit/rank pool and the two counts, so both hidden hands must have the same S9 value. The known-transfer-copy ownership flag excludes this root even though the remaining copy-ID distinction carries no additional game-resource value condition.
nonblockingObservations.recommendation: It is permissible to retain this conservative exclusion and disclose the narrower eligible set. Any refinement should use a pre-score mechanical implication/equivalent-copy proof, never teacher support rates or outcomes. This observation alone does not block the pilot.

nonblockingObservations.interpretation: The three exchange flags are an initial conservative filter, not proof that317+14 is a sufficient statistic for all complete public history or every continuation policy. Future concrete encoder collisions or policy-history dependencies still need diagnosis before their labels are consumed.

frozenWorldUnitTests.redReceiptInterpretation: The stored red receipt is a module-load failure before implementation, not four executed behavioral assertion failures. The green receipt and independent temporary run each execute all four tests.

ordinaryProjection.limit: This passes for ordinary canonical source values; it does not close the nested-extra leak above.

positiveIndependentChecks.uniformityReasoning: For a fixed canonical visible input, Fisher-Yates permutes the unseen card pool, then fills fixed per-seat deficits. Every unordered physical allocation has the same product-of-seat-factorials multiplicity; subsequent within-hand shuffles also have fixed multiplicity. Conditioning this proposal on the same legal public-history/exchange predicate preserves uniformity under the transparent pseudorandom-shuffle assumption. Re-encoding is constant on worlds preserving the own/public facts. The512 empirical counts are descriptive, not a statistical proof of uniformity or a criterion for selecting favorable roots.
positiveIndependentChecks.passCodeInspection: Neither playedBy nor root-history replay infers inability from pass. resolveLegalMove only requires that a target exists for passing. All64 sampled worlds in the optional-pass witness still let the passer beat the target.

schemaAssessment.eligibilityRule: Keep the conservative filter/version fixed before teacher scores. An empty list means none of these implemented checks fired; it is not a general historical sufficiency certificate.

The accepted public-rule domain and attempt-limit boundary need explicit closure before the module is approved as a bounded pilot sampler.

cyclePreservation.scope: The same review6-humanlike-20261028 cycle still has one initialize entry and the once-only H reserve/settle pair. Prior H/baseline proof is reused; no fresh H/model/formal result audit or new attempt is performed.

executionSafety.mechanicalFixtures: Handcrafted legal histories, visible allocations and pure engine rule-result checks only; no root-action preference or teacher outcome labels were generated.

instrumentationLimit: Only the separate visible-world-instrumented temporary copy adds a side-effect-only loop-iteration counter to establish the ordinary3-attempt bound. All acceptance, uniformity, leak, pass and rule/gap probes use the unmodified frozen logic with dependency import paths relocated. No production source or evidence was edited.
limitations: This report does not approve teacher quality, C3 overall, labels, policy improvement, main training or formal evaluation.
Uniformity is conditional on the stated own/public information set and legal-rejection rules; no calibrated human behavior weighting is claimed.
The fixed seed sample frequencies and toy worlds are diagnostics only, not game-strength evidence or a license to alter eligibility after model outcomes.
Root-history/public-exchange checks and H/baseline results remain as independently reviewed; they were not replaced or rerun.
